verdict.rationale: Three.js is scripted directly in JavaScript/TypeScript, so the 'scripting language' is the same language exposing the full engine API natively (no separate restricted script layer), and standard browser devtools plus a dedicated Three.js DevTools browser extension provide debugging support (threejs-docs-8). Community confirms TypeScript works well for productive full API access (threejs-comm-5), though with some type-definition mismatches requiring @ts-ignore workarounds (threejs-comm-6), and some users report friction with certain workflows (threejs-comm-3, threejs-comm-4). Missing for 10: dedicated first-party documentation of the devtools extension's debugging features, and independent hands-on verification of the debugger's depth/usefulness.
